turns.patient_response: Lately I’ve been feeling like I’m not handling stress very well at all. Ever since a few things changed in my life recently, I’ve been reacting in ways that don’t feel normal for me and it’s starting to affect my day-to-day life.

symptom_reasoning.S081: The patient describes not handling stress well and having new, uncharacteristic reactions since recent life changes that are affecting daily functioning, consistent with a stress-related maladaptive response to identifiable stressors.
